device: one inverter-based unit, terminal measurements at its point of connection

columns.time_s: s from the start of the recording
columns.active_power_pu: P injected by the device, pu on its rating
columns.reactive_power_pu: Q injected by the device, pu on its rating
columns.bus_angle_rad: terminal voltage angle, rad, relative to its value at t = 0
columns.voltage_setpoint_pu: device voltage setpoint from the control log, pu (not a measurement, no noise)

notes: PMU-grade measurements. Staged voltage-reference tests are logged with their times. Ambient recordings have no switching events.
